title: Works With Issues
text: Works With Issues. At first I was sure this was going to burn out my mixer. Seems like a good tool to do that. Zero guidance or recipes about the consistency of the dough that is recommended. I had inadvertently used a 100 % whole wheat semolina. That was a mistake. This machine doesn't have the balls to extrude that kind of dough even if it is attached to a Kitchen Aid.  Going to try it again with regular semolina and see if that matters.  However, this  attachment is awful to clean. The dough is jammed in and the parts won't come undone. I had to soak it forever and thought I might have to get manly help to get it apart.  Not something I will use very often with the issues I have mentioned.
